configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

limitations: 静态图像审核策略sampled_0p2_continuous_actions：基础帧每0.2秒（零基0,5,10,…,705及709）；动作与疑点按25fps连续源帧复核。因无可靠动作-PTS映射，将复核区间扩大至0–28.36秒；178批，每批最多4时间点×3视角。不是实时连续播放，具体实际检查记录以inspected_index为准。
确认次数为可用RGB和完整执行日志支持的下界；遮挡、深度不明及帧间亚40毫秒事件不能完全排除。图像投影重叠不单独证明异常碰撞。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

metric_reasons.collision_arm_object: E-contact-cup：右指接触杯缘并短暂倾斜确认1；释放后瓶翻倒的撤臂推碰原因仍不确定，E-topple-contact候选不加计。
metric_reasons.collision_arm_table: 完整提供日志及三视角全时段基础/连续动作复核范围内未确认发生；0是确认下界。
metric_reasons.knockdown: 杯短暂倾斜后复位，瓶为操作目标且主动释放后倒；其他物品未确认被碰倒。
metric_reasons.wrong_object: 原始任务指令正文在本run全部可用证据中缺失；虽操作瓶和杯符合任务名，不能据此确认完整目标选择约束。
metric_reasons.fine_placement_fail: 无插入/套入/悬挂/装配/堆叠/精确对齐放置尝试；普通桌面放回翻倒及倒液对准失败作为辅助事件，不扩展此指标定义。

uncertainties: U-instruction：递归检查本run全部10个文件及7个JSON（含result内嵌证据、配置name/value和historical-l3-eef引用），未找到原始任务指令正文；仅有任务名、prompt哈希和控制指南。m25=null。建议main补原始任务prompt/目标约束，不从其他run套用。
U-mapping：三路视频均25fps、414帧、PTS 0–16.52秒；日志370原生控制步且没有帧/控制步收录映射。decision与policy_step在拒绝后偏移，不能用视频帧替代。动作视觉复核范围保守扩大到全时段；精确动作时刻/事件env_step留空。建议main补录制器控制步时间戳。
U-budget：actions.json decision43明确因remaining motion budget放弃恢复，但未明确接近或达到上限，整体动作上限缺失；20是单阶段cap，100是决策上限。放弃前369原生步、44th模型响应，无法分类m17/m19；确认下界0并列候选。建议main核查原始全局预算及该次响应上下文。
U-topple-contact：瓶在释放后撤臂时倾倒，15.04–16.52秒三视角已连续静态帧复核；15.36–16.00秒夹爪遮挡且与瓶二维重叠，不能确认是否另有非预期推碰。m22确认下界1，另列未确认候选。建议main查该时段物理接触/姿态日志。
U-fill：10.12–11.80秒可见部分流入杯、明显杯外洒液；图像不足以量化杯内液量或原任务所需比例。保留原生success=false、score=0，不用模型描述/末次ACK true覆盖。
limitations: 采用静态图像分批审核：0.2秒基础策略（每5帧及末帧）；由于PTS/控制映射不可靠，将所有动作区间扩展至0–16.52秒，按0.04秒源帧间隔复核。非连续播放；不以抽帧方法作绝无短暂事件的保证。

Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

metric_reasons.collision_arms: C1与C2两次分离的腕部非预期接触；多视角外壳/夹指挤靠、姿态受阻及物体受扰，与日志失败到位/干涉note一致。
metric_reasons.collision_arm_object: C2右夹指抵近并挤动左持红T，确认一次；C1红T附近遮挡接触归属不清，作为Ucontact候选另列。正常抓取接触不计。
metric_reasons.collision_arm_table: 在声明的基础扫描与动作连续源帧复核范围内未确认异常桌面碰撞；正常近桌抓取/放置不计。
metric_reasons.knockdown: 未见其他场景物体被碰倒，但完整原始任务指令缺失，不能独立核实红蓝T的目标/非目标角色；红T自身掉落翻转按掉落记录。
metric_reasons.wrong_object: 查遍本run七个JSON及嵌入historical-l3-eef相关证据，只有任务名、prompt标识/摘要和动作note，无原始任务指令，不能独立判定选错目标。
metric_reasons.fine_placement_fail: 最终蓝T主动放桌且稳定；没有原始精确目标位姿/验收容差，无法判定该精确对齐是否失败。未完成红T交换不自动算精细放置失败。

uncertainties: 原始任务指令缺失：本run所有7个原始JSON、result嵌入evidence及本包assignment已查；historical-l3-eef仅标识，配置仅含工具指导。main需补原始任务prompt和验收几何；m24/m25/m26不可完整判定。
T1预算归类缺失：actions.json#/35原文remaining motion budget is insufficient；已用362控制但总限额未知，不能判断≥90%或已达到。main核查原执行器预算，m17/m19=null。
PTS到控制步未映射：25fps/402帧与363控制不同，无显式逐步时间戳。物理事件decision/env字段留null；日志关联只表示上下文。main需原始带时间戳轨迹，勿按帧号换算。
Ucontact：7.80–8.72秒左腕红T接触点遮挡；C1腕部接触确认，额外腕物接触未确认。m22=1确认下界，main可查该时段接触对/深度。
limitations: 方法为完整读取日志、三视角0.2秒基础扫描、动作/疑点连续源帧静态检查；不是连续播放视频。因控制映射不可靠，连续复核窗口扩大至0–16.04秒；coverage保留实际逐帧记录，不以提取数量冒充检查。
基础indices为零基0,5,...,400及末帧401；源帧间隔0.04秒。共101批，每批最多4时间点×3视角，保留先前实际检查记录。
静态RGB与25fps源视频不能排除源帧之间的短暂事件或被遮挡接触；计数是本审核范围确认下界，0不表示绝无发生。
无法映射的精确物理事件turn/env_step留null；字符串证据字段在schema不允许null时用解释或空串表示不适用，非伪造定位。
原生末次物理ACK success=true与最终success=false并存；最终success取明确original native result。
native status complete代表导出完成，不等于任务成功；本次review complete也不代表任务成功。

groups.name: persistent-cap20
groups.coverage: 动作前观测 + 视频片段补查

setting.label: persistent-cap20
setting.source: result.json → protocol / model / evidence.config.parameters（42 条一致）
notes: 42 条运行的设置逐条核对一致；仅每 run 的 manifest/hash 字段不同。

methodology: 检查42个case的result.json执行轨迹与三路MP4。校验2,674轮动作前观测、8,022张三视角图像；视觉复核覆盖每次夹爪指令及相邻观测、换手与观察动作。疑难提拉/失持及直接换手另查看视频内采样帧，部分片段逐帧加密；并非逐帧穷尽观看全部视频。
空夹后重试：实际闭合但未形成有效抓取，之后对同一物体重新接近或重试；可跨轮次或换臂。仅发出闭合计划、未执行闭合不计；最终空夹且没有后续重试不计此类。
夹取后掉落：物体离开支撑并随手运动，随后在主动松爪前失持。同一物体一次失持只计一次。主动释放后的倒下或落偏归放置失败。
待确认：夹指遮挡或支撑接触不清，使空夹、支撑滑移、短暂提起后掉落无法可靠区分；不进入确认空夹或确认掉落。因此确认数是保守计数，0表示未确认发现。
换手按同一物体跨左右手计。分别记录桌面中转、任务支撑面中转、直接稳定成功、直接尝试失败和掉落后另一手恢复。直接稳定成功要求供给手释放后接收手继续保持并执行后续动作；实际接近受阻也可构成失败尝试，纯文字计划不计。
补视野：另一臂实际移动以补足执行臂缺失的几何观察，包含观察臂撤离以恢复可见性；执行臂自看、常规闲臂扫描、仅清运动路径和被拒未动均排除。同一未解决缺口的连续调整计一轮；恢复执行后再次出现缺口计新一轮。动作数按实际运动的轨迹turn计。
cap20可能截断移动或夹爪动作。统计结合executed_waypoints、后续夹爪状态和图像，不以请求targets或accepted作为实际完成证据。模型note只作定位线索，不单独证明夹取或掉落。
T为本报告1起始轨迹序号；P为原始policy_step；E为动作前env_step；F为各MP4内0起始帧号，F不等于E。执行视频帧区间为[start,end)。事件列出的T覆盖动作前、动作与后续结果，非每个T各计一次。
原生分数原样保留；完全成功数按score==1计算。补充发现仅是检查中遇到的示例，未对碰撞、放置失败、洒漏等作穷尽统计。当前数量是事件数，不是以抓取机会数为分母的失败率。
与semantic-eef旧报告比较时须注意证据差异：本组有连续视频补查，旧组主要基于稀疏动作前图像；待确认事件占比和可确认事件数会受此影响。

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

definitions.label: 成功
definitions.description: 取原生结果的 success；score==1 才算成功。不得用模型自述、accepted 或 note 判定。

definitions.label: 得分
definitions.description: 原生任务得分，范围 0–1；与 success 分开保留，不用得分反推成功。

definitions.label: 总体轮数
definitions.description: semantic-eef：原生模型决策轮；轨迹记录与宏执行阶段分列。历史组按其来源定义。

definitions.label: 总体 action 次数
definitions.description: 仅指实际执行的控制步数：双臂同步一步计一个环境控制步；规划器拒绝的调用和未执行计划不计；须与原生累计值核对并解释差异。

definitions.label: 空夹次数
definitions.description: semantic-eef：实际闭合但未形成有效夹持，包含之后没有重试的空夹；正常按压、推物、空手收爪不计；每次独立抓取尝试计一次。 其他组核查范围与历史口径见组说明。

definitions.label: 夹取掉落次数
definitions.description: semantic-eef：已离开支撑并形成夹持，随后在主动释放前失持；主动释放后的倒下或落偏不计入掉落。 其他组核查范围与历史口径见组说明。

definitions.label: 空夹后成功重夹次数
definitions.description: 同一物体在空夹后重新形成有效夹持，并在后续提拉或搬运中保持；连续多次空夹后一次抓稳只计一次，须关联此前失败链，不能重复归因。

definitions.label: 掉落后成功重夹次数
definitions.description: 同一物体在掉落后重新形成有效夹持并保持；关联掉落事件，同一掉落链只计一次成功重夹。

definitions.label: 直接换手出现次数
definitions.description: 两臂直接转交同一物体的实际执行尝试，包含失败的尝试；纯文字计划不计。

definitions.label: 直接换手成功次数
definitions.description: 要求接收臂独立保持该物体并继续操作，供给臂已释放；仅接触不算成功。

definitions.label: 桌面换手出现次数
definitions.description: 经由裸桌面中转换手的实际执行尝试；意外掉落之后另一臂拾取属于辅助事件，不算桌面换手。

definitions.label: 桌面换手成功次数
definitions.description: 中转后接收臂重新持物并继续操作。

definitions.label: 其他支撑面换手出现次数
definitions.description: 经由桌面以外的支撑结构（容器边缘、支架等）中转换手，与桌面中转分开计数。

definitions.label: 其他支撑面换手成功次数
definitions.description: 中转后接收臂重新持物并继续操作。

definitions.label: 同手臂补视野次数
definitions.description: semantic-eef：执行臂为补足自身缺失观察而实际移动；普通任务接近、仅为避碰的移动不计；按实际执行的轨迹动作阶段计，一个阶段同类计一次。 其他组核查范围与历史口径见组说明。

definitions.label: 异侧手臂补视野次数
definitions.description: semantic-eef：另一臂补看执行臂被遮挡区域，或撤离以恢复可见性；按动作阶段计。同一观察缺口的连续动作以 gap_id 关联，不与“观察轮数”混用。 其他组核查范围与历史口径见组说明。

definitions.label: 靠近动作上限时主动放弃
definitions.description: 动作预算使用率 ≥90% 且尚未达到上限时，明确执行或记录主动放弃，并有证据表明该预算是放弃原因；自动耗尽终止不算。

definitions.label: 靠近 turn 上限时主动放弃
definitions.description: 同上，针对 turn 预算。

definitions.label: 达到动作上限时主动放弃
definitions.description: 动作预算已耗尽且明确记录主动放弃；与“靠近动作上限”互斥，同一预算不得同时计两类。

definitions.label: 达到 turn 上限时主动放弃
definitions.description: turn 预算已耗尽且明确记录主动放弃；与“靠近 turn 上限”互斥。两种预算同时满足时分别记录，并注明是同一终止事件。

definitions.label: 两手臂之间异常碰撞
definitions.description: 要求实际非预期接触；正常抓取、推物、按压、装配接触及规划器拒绝不计；一次连续接触只计一次，分离后再次接触才算新事件。

definitions.label: 手臂与物体异常碰撞
definitions.description: 同上；正常操作中的有意接触不计。

definitions.label: 手臂与桌面异常碰撞
definitions.description: 同上；抓取平面上的正常按压与放置不计。

definitions.label: 非目标物被碰倒
definitions.description: 实际操作导致非目标物倒下或翻倒；仅被平移不计；同一动作可同时计入对应异常碰撞。

definitions.label: 选错物体
definitions.description: 实际开始操作的对象不符合任务要求；仅文字判断错误不计；合法的中间操作或工具使用不计。

definitions.label: 精细放置失败
definitions.description: 一次实际插入、套入、悬挂、装配、堆叠或精确对齐尝试未达到要求；连续执行中的微调不逐帧计数；退出后重新尝试算新一次；普通搬运掉落不计此项。

protocol.title: RoboDojo 行为看板 · 提交标准
protocol.lede: 面向其他 agent 的提交契约：按本规范产出的包，通过校验后可直接同步进看板，无需人工改数据。

inputs: “靠近预算上限”阈值：使用率 ≥90% 且未达到上限
must: 读取 MANIFEST、demo.json 或 result.json、原始执行轨迹、配置、三视角图像及视频。
保留全部任务，包括失败与提前终止；同一任务多个 run 分行记录，不合并。
不得修改原始数据，也不得用模型自述代替实际执行或视觉证据。
完整读取轨迹，结合三视角核查动作前、中、后状态；疑难事件查看连续视频。
无法可靠判断的事件单列（uncertain），不强行分类。

metrics.label: 成功与否
metrics.rule: 取原生结果的 success；score==1 才算成功。不得用模型自述、accepted 或 note 判定。

metrics.rule: 原生任务得分，范围 0–1；与 success 分开保留，不用得分反推成功。

metrics.label: 总体 action 次数
metrics.rule: 仅指实际执行的控制步数：双臂同步一步计一个环境控制步；规划器拒绝的调用和未执行计划不计；须与原生累计值核对并解释差异。

metrics.label: 空夹次数
metrics.rule: 实际闭合但未形成有效夹持，包含之后没有重试的空夹；正常按压、推物、空手收爪不计；每次独立抓取尝试计一次。

metrics.label: 夹取掉落次数
metrics.rule: 已离开支撑并形成夹持，随后在主动释放前失持；主动释放后的倒下或落偏不计入掉落。

metrics.label: 空夹后成功重夹次数

metrics.label: 桌面换手成功次数

metrics.label: 其他支撑面换手出现次数

metrics.label: 其他支撑面换手成功次数

metrics.label: 靠近动作上限主动放弃次数
metrics.rule: 动作预算使用率 ≥90% 且尚未达到上限时，明确执行或记录主动放弃，并有证据表明该预算是放弃原因；自动耗尽终止不算。

metrics.label: 达到动作上限主动放弃次数

metrics.label: 达到 turn 上限主动放弃次数
metrics.rule: turn 预算已耗尽且明确记录主动放弃；与“靠近 turn 上限”互斥。两种预算同时满足时分别记录，并注明是同一终止事件。

metrics.label: 两手臂非正常碰撞次数
metrics.rule: 要求实际非预期接触；正常抓取、推物、按压、装配接触及规划器拒绝不计；一次连续接触只计一次，分离后再次接触才算新事件。

metrics.label: 手臂与桌面非正常碰撞次数

metric_status.label: 已确认

metric_status.rule: 数据缺失或定义无法核实。

metric_status.label: 待审核
metric_status.rule: 核查尚未完成；指标值留空，旧值单列保留。有任何待审核项时只能交付阶段性结果，不得写NA或0冒充完成。

cross_rules: 同一次直接换手失败后改为桌面中转：直接尝试计 1 次、桌面尝试计 1 次，分别记录。
意外掉落后由另一臂拾取：单列辅助事件（recovery_other），不算有意的桌面换手。
视野调整按实际执行的轨迹动作阶段计数；同一观察缺口的连续动作以 gap_id 关联，不与观察轮数混用。
动作预算与 turn 预算分别判断；同一预算的“靠近”与“达到”互斥；两种预算同时满足时分别记录并注明同一终止事件。
动作和turn独立判断：仅将缺少该类上限、终止或因果证据的相关指标标unknown，不联动清空另一类已知指标。不得用模型自述的剩余预算反推总上限。
视频事件无法精确到轮次时：turn_precision 写 unknown 或 approx，并用 frame 或 time_range 定位；不要用近似轮次冒充精确值。
计数是“确认下界”：0 只表示在已说明的核查范围内未确认发现，不代表连续时间绝无发生。
不同类别的事件不能相加当作“总失败次数”。

categories.label: 空夹后重试
categories.rule: 闭合未形成有效夹持后，针对同一物体重新尝试。

categories.label: 夹起后掉落
categories.rule: 已形成夹持并离开支撑，主动释放前失持。

categories.label: 直接换手成功
categories.rule: 接收臂独立保持并继续操作。

categories.label: 支撑面中转换手
categories.rule: 经非桌面支撑结构完成转交。

categories.label: 另一手恢复（辅助）
categories.rule: 掉落或失持后另一臂拾取，不计为有意换手。

categories.label: 补视野
categories.rule: 为补足缺失观察而实际移动的手臂动作。

categories.label: 其他补充发现
categories.rule: 不属于以上类别但值得记录的观察。

fields.rule: 执行臂，如 左 / 右 / 左→右。
1-based 轮次窗口，升序。无法映射到轮次时留空，但必须用 frame 或 time_range 定位。
exact / approx / unknown。轮次只是近似窗口时写 approx；完全无法映射时写 unknown，不得用推测值凑数。
视频秒数区间 [start, end]，用于只能在连续视频里定位、无法对应到轮次的事件。
动作所在环境步；未知写 null。
头部相机帧号；未知写 null。
该事件的结局，须与计数一致。
判定依据：看过的图像/视频与关键画面。
确认 / 待确认；待确认事件不得计入确认计数。
证据引用：每项 {camera, url|null, sha256, bytes}。有公开 URL 时看板直接外链。
同一观察缺口的连续补视野动作共享该 id。

rules: 看板不托管图片或视频：证据必须给出公开可访问的 URL（原始存储直链）；没有公开 URL 时写 url=null 并给出 sha256，看板只显示文字证据。
不得上传裁剪、缩放、加字或插值的派生帧作为唯一证据；如需截图，仅作辅助并保留原始视频链接。
accepted、夹爪零开度、模型 note、请求 targets 均不能单独证明成功、掉落或碰撞。
特别核对动作截断：请求闭合或释放不等于已执行。

files.name: submission.json
files.rule: 权威数据：组设置 + 每个 run 的 26 项指标、状态、事件与媒体引用。看板只读这个文件。

files.name: task_metrics.csv
files.rule: 逐 run 一行的扁平镜像，必须与 submission.json 完全一致（校验器逐格比对）。

files.name: events.json
files.rule: 事件明细数组，按 run_id 归属；与 submission.json 内嵌事件同源。

files.name: report.html
files.rule: 可筛选的本地报告：逐任务表、汇总、事件证据与不确定项。

blocking: submission.json 通过 JSON Schema；schema_version 正确。
组的 setting 必填：setting_id、profile 或明确的 null + 原因；不得用组名代替配置。
run_id 全局唯一；同一 (task, variant, scene, seed) 允许多条，但必须各自有 run_id 并标记 repeat。
每个 run 含全部 26 项指标，且每项都有 status（confirmed / lower_bound / na / unknown / pending）。
success==1 时 score 必须为 1；success==0 时 score<1 或 null。
掉落后重夹 ≤ 掉落次数；空夹后重夹 ≤ 空夹次数。
每个事件必须能被定位：turns 非空、frame 非空、time_range 三者至少其一。
turns 若给出必须是 >=1 的整数且升序；turn_precision=unknown 时允许为空数组。
turn_precision=exact/approx 时 turns 不得为空；unknown 时不得编造轮次。
每个事件必须引用存在的 run_id，category 在枚举内。
confidence=待确认 的事件不得计入任何确认计数。
媒体引用必须带 sha256；url 非空时必须 https。
task_metrics.csv 每行必须与 submission.json 对应 run 的数值完全一致。
不得修改原始数据；报告中的数值必须能由包内文件复算。
warnings: 存在 na / unknown 指标：报告须列出未覆盖类别。
没有任何事件证据的 run：允许，但报告须说明核查范围。
覆盖率低于 100%（事件数 < 成功/失败链应有数量）：提示可能漏标。
同一 (task, variant, scene, seed) 出现多条 run：看板将按均值 ± 标准差展示，并披露全部重跑。
媒体 url 为 null：该事件在看板上只有文字证据。

layout: ├─ task_metrics.csv    # 与 submission.json 一致的镜像
steps: 默认同步目标是云端看板：校验通过后把包放进 submissions/<group_id>/ 并提 PR，合并即自动同步，通常不需要任何本地命令。
CI 在 PR 上运行 validate_submission.py；0 阻断才允许合并，阻断项直接贴在 PR 里。
合并后 publish-submission 自动执行 ingest --merge 写入 data.js，并提交一次 bot commit。
Pages 随后发布，新组出现在“实验设置”选择器里，seed / scene / variant 自动进入筛选项（约 1–3 分钟）。
无法访问仓库时走 issue 提交或由维护者本地兜底：python3 ingest_submission.py <submission> --merge。
发布快照：记录 submission 文件的 sha256，旧快照不覆盖，纠错发新版本。
mapping: submission.group → 选择器中的“实验设置”；setting_id 相同即同一设置。
run.episode(task, variant, scene, seed) → 选择器的 task / variant / seed / scene。
run.metrics[26] + metric_status → 逐任务矩阵与任务详情。
run.events[] → 事件与证据页；media.url 直接外链，无 URL 时只显示文字。
run.configuration + run.videos + run.artifacts → 任务详情中的设置与溯源区块。
report 覆盖率与 na/unknown 清单 → 总览中的“证据覆盖”与待补标提示。

example_fields: schema_version
固定为 robodojo-submission-v1；不匹配直接拒绝。
group.id / group.name
实验组标识与展示名；看板“实验设置”选择器用它。
group.setting
配置指纹：setting_id 为配置内容的 sha256；profile、上限、模型、客户端版本必填，未知写 null 并给 reason。
group.coverage
本次核查覆盖说明（哪些类别看了全视频、哪些只看稀疏帧）。
runs[].run_id
全局唯一；重复运行另起 run_id，并令 repeat=1。
runs[].task / variant / scene / seed / capability
任务条件键，看板按这五项筛选与配对。
runs[].result
原生结果：success、score、turns、actions，不用模型自述替代。
runs[].metrics
26 项指标；未知写 null，不要写 0。
runs[].metric_status
每项指标的核查状态，取值 confirmed / lower_bound / na / unknown / pending。
runs[].configuration
实际生效配置快照，用于跨组对比与复现。
runs[].videos[]
三视角原始视频：camera、url（公开直链或 null）、sha256、bytes。
runs[].artifacts[]
原生产物（native_terminal / actions / config / source_lock）及哈希。
runs[].events[]
事件证据；字段见 4.2，待确认事件不得计入确认计数。

needs: 目标仓库地址（见 protocol.json 的 submit.repo）
自检命令 validate_submission.py，必须 0 阻断
with_git: # 0 · 自检：必须 0 阻断，否则不必提交
# 2 · 放入提交包（4 个文件）
without_git: 把 submission.json / task_metrics.csv / events.json（可选 report.html）打包，
上传到任意可公开下载的地址（zip 或目录均可）。
开 issue 选择「提交实验组」，填写 group_id、bundle 地址、submission.json 的 sha256。
维护者下载后跑同一条校验命令入库；你会在 issue 里收到通过或阻断原因。
after_pr: CI 自动运行 validate_submission.py，结果直接贴在 PR 上。
维护者 review 口径：覆盖范围、na 是否合理、事件证据是否指向可公开访问的原始文件。
合并后 CI 自动执行 ingest_submission.py --merge，把组写进 data.js 并提交。
Pages 随后自动发布，新组出现在「实验设置」选择器里，通常 10 分钟内。
update_rules: 同一 group_id 重新提交 = 覆盖该组数据；旧版本保留在 git 历史里。
配置变了必须换 setting_id，不能沿用旧指纹，否则会被当成同一设置。
数值纠错要说明原因，且不得删除历史提交。
已被拒绝的包可以改好后重开 PR；不要新建重复的 group_id。
